## 3. Brand Message Library

- Primary Website Headline: Practical software for real workflows.
- GitHub Organization Headline: Free Open-Source Tools for Developers and Teams
- GitHub Organization Tagline: Deploy. Connect. Scale.
- Community / Philosophy Tagline: Build Useful Tools. Share Them Openly.
- Mission: Build free and open-source tools that help people do real work with less complexity.
- Short Brand Description: Vib Tools builds practical software, desktop applications, automation tools, self-hosted services, developer utilities, and reusable open-source projects for real technical and business workflows.
- Medium Brand Description: Vib Tools is a software organization focused on practical, transparent, and maintainable tools. Its work spans Windows desktop applications, automation systems, self-hosted services, developer utilities, reusable frameworks, structured project templates, and public open-source software. The organization emphasizes clear scope, visible project maturity, documentation, maintainability, user control, and software that solves focused real-world problems without unnecessary platform complexity.

## 4. Primary Product Catalog (10 Projects Across 4 Categories)

### Desktop Apps (4 Projects)
1. Portable Account Browser (https://github.com/vibtools/PortableAccountBrowser) - Available, Free, Open Source. Portable multi-account Chromium browser for Windows desktop. Keeps multiple web accounts separated in isolated portable profiles.
2. ContextVault (https://github.com/vibtools/ContextVault) - Available, Free, Open Source. Portable ChatGPT conversation archive tool for Windows desktop. Saves fully loaded ChatGPT conversations as portable, integrity-checked RAG-ready archives.
3. Invio (https://github.com/vibtools/invio) - Active development. Provider-based invoice automation Windows desktop application.
4. VibraPilot (https://github.com/vibtools/VibraPilot) - Active development, Open Source. Browser automation desktop application with managed sessions and Windows-focused runtime controls.

### Web Apps / Self-Hosted (3 Projects)
5. MailStack (https://github.com/vibtools/MailStack) - Available, Open Source. Self-hosted business mail server and shared team inbox. Open-source receive-only email infrastructure.
6. Licora (https://github.com/vibtools/Licora) - Available, Open Source. Central software license management system. Software licensing, product access, device limits, API validation, and audit operations.
7. Vib ID Account Portal (https://github.com/vibtools/vib-id-account-portal) - Available. Central web identity/account portal for Vib Tools services (profile, security, 2FA, sessions, application management).

### Developer Tools (2 Projects)
8. InvoiceRouter for n8n (https://github.com/vibtools/n8n-nodes-invoicerouter) - Active development, Open Source. n8n automation node for provider invoice lifecycles, account allocation, and retries.
9. Vibrix (https://github.com/vibtools/vibrix) - Early development, Open Source. Python/PySide6 desktop UI framework for consistent, scalable, production-oriented desktop software.

### Templates (1 Project)
10. Vib Project Template (https://github.com/vibtools/vibproject-template) - Available, Free, Open Source. Reusable technology-neutral structure with boundaries for source, tests, documentation, scripts, and assets.
